title: The Open-Weight Release
briefing: A US-headquartered laboratory with a large London office will release the weights of a powerful model. Its cyber capability is about six months behind the closed frontier, and safeguards can be removed after release. The UK cannot stop it.

forecast.question: Chance this model family is implicated in a serious UK security incident by 2030.

briefingSignal.leansTrue: Assessment: red teams stripped the safeguards in days and the derivative materially sped up intrusion work. Openly available capability at this level is likely to help attackers more than defenders.
briefingSignal.leansFalse: Assessment: red teams stripped the safeguards in days, but defenders gained as much from the derivative as attackers did. Openly available capability at this level is not clearly a net gift to offence.

shah.stance: Six months behind the frontier means the marginal risk is measurable. Get our evaluators in before release and measure it.

harcourt.stance: Once the weights are out, every safeguard is optional. Keep derivatives away from anything that matters.

chen.stance: This is the best free research asset the UK will be handed this decade. Build on it.

okafor.stance: We cannot stop this release, or the next one. The only durable answer is a threshold agreed with allies.

choices.text: Welcome the release and fund UK researchers to build on it.
choices.headline: Government welcomes the open-weight release and funds UK researchers to build on it.

choices.text: Negotiate early evaluation access and a staged release.

onFailure.headline: The laboratory declines early access for UK evaluators; the release goes ahead as planned.

choices.headline: The laboratory agrees to early UK evaluation access and a staged release.

choices.text: Bar unsafeguarded derivatives from government and critical sectors.
choices.headline: Unsafeguarded derivatives are barred from government and critical sectors; use elsewhere is unaffected.

choices.text: Convene allies on a shared threshold for open release.
choices.headline: The UK convenes allied governments to negotiate a shared threshold for open release.

evidencePanel.known: Safeguards on released weights can be removed cheaply, and released weights cannot be recalled.
evidencePanel.unknown: Whether capability at this level, openly available, helps attackers more than it helps defenders.
evidencePanel.whyItMatters: If the marginal risk is small, restriction buys little and costs a research base. If it is large, the release cannot be undone.

sources.label: US NTIA, Dual-Use Foundation Models with Widely Available Model Weights (2024)
